fields.zone: The physical area or room where the record applies.
fields.role: The job title or personnel classification.
fields.authorization: Whether access or action is permitted.
fields.station: The specific equipment or workstation identifier.
fields.sensor: The type of sensor measuring the value.
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the sensor value.
fields.nominal: The target or normal operating range/value.
fields.critical_response: The required action when a critical threshold is reached.
fields.action: The required response or corrective measure.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger or prose stating when a rule applies.
fields.depends_on: The upstream station or system this record depends on.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of this station's state on subsequent processes.
fields.priority: The importance or criticality level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of people allowed in the zone.
fields.enforcement: The rules governing how limits are enforced.
fields.anomaly_type: The classification of the detected anomaly.
fields.definition: The prose description of what constitutes the anomaly.
fields.detection_criterion: The technical logic used to detect the anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal system classification of the event.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: Maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning in minutes.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: Maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm in minutes.
fields.requirement: The mandatory rule or policy statement.
fields.pattern: The observed sequence or relationship between events.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause of the failure.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting symptoms or side effects of the fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to fix the issue.
fields.critical_condition: The specific prose trigger for a critical state.
fields.critical_action: The specific action required for a critical state.
fields.station_dependencies: The flow of dependencies between stations.
fields.fault_propagation: How faults move through the system.
fields.correlation: The relationship between two different sensor readings.
fields.diagnosis: The identified cause of the problem.
fields.authorized_personnel: The specific roles or training required for access.
fields.unauthorized_access_action: The action required when unauthorized access is detected.
fields.primary_criterion: The main goal or standard being measured.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The logical ordering of alarm levels.

categories.AccessAuthorization: Rules regarding who can enter or act.
categories.AlarmThreshold: Numeric limits for warnings and criticals.
categories.StationDependency: How stations relate to one another in a process.
categories.OccupancyLimit: Maximum allowed people in a zone.
categories.AcknowledgmentTime: Time limits for responding to alarms.
categories.FaultDiagnosis: Identification of the cause of a fault.
categories.VerificationProcedure: Steps to verify a state or fix.
